_doc: credit-verify-outbound.sh CAPACITY caps (Fable 10-30 23:4xZ: the fixed small daily caps go; the safety is the auto-kill: bounce / spam / unsub > 2 %, any fraud hit, the zero-read, v1's 2 h sample). daily_cap = users messaged per campaign per UTC day by segment (credit: the runner's own segment record; claim: ledger rows of the campaign). shared_daily_cap = every campaign of the group together per UTC day (m2's shared send cap inside notify: credit 2,500 / claim 500; messaging-monitoring-m2, H-DevOps #4598). A campaign with no row or no group never applies (fail closed). Raising a cap is a PR.
